                                                                                                                釋義

In this annual report, the following expressions shall have the following         於本年報內，除文義另有所指外，下列詞彙
meanings unless the context indicates otherwise:                                  具有以下涵義：

“Aggregate Trade Balance”                     the total balances of the net trade receivables, net bills receivable and acceptance
                                              bills which are received from the customers to settle their trade debts
「貿易應收總款項」                                     貿易應收賬款淨額、應收票據淨額及承兌票據款項（從客戶收取以結算其貿易
                                              債務）之總額

“AGM”                                         the annual general meeting of the Company or any adjournment thereof
「股東週年大會」                                      本公司股東週年大會或其任何續會

“Articles”                                    the articles of association of the Company, as amended, supplemented, modified
                                              or otherwise adopted from time to time
「章程細則」                                        本公司不時修訂、補充、修改或以其他方式採納的公司章程細則

“AsiaInfo Technologies Limited”               a company listed on the Main Board of the Stock Exchange (stock code: 01675)
「亞信科技控股有限公司」                                  是一家在聯交所主板上市的公司（股票代號：01675）

“Associates”                                  has the meaning ascribed to an “associate” under Rule 14A.06(2) of the Listing
                                              Rules, and further includes any company that constitutes a connected subsidiary
                                              of the Company pursuant to Rule 14A.16 of the Listing Rules due to such
                                              associate’s shareholding therein
「聯繫人（含關連附屬公司）」                                具 上 市 規 則 第 14A.06(2) 條 所 賦 予 的 涵 義， 且 進 一 步 包 括 根 據 上 市 規 則 第
                                              14A.16 條構成本公司關連附屬公司之任何公司（由於有關聯繫人於該等關連附
                                              屬公司持股）

“associate(s)”                                has the meaning ascribed thereto under the Listing Rules
「聯繫人」                                         具上市規則所賦予的涵義

RISK MANAGEMENT POLICY AND KEY INTERNAL CONTROL MEASURES                            風險管理政策及關鍵內部控制措施
CREDIT APPROVAL PROCESS AND CREDIT RISK ASSESSMENT POLICY                           信貸審批流程與信貸風險評估政策
Prior to the granting of financial services to the borrowers, the relevant          在向借款人提供金融服務之前，金融分部相
business units (“Business Unit(s)”) of the Finance Segment will first review the    關業務部門（「業務部門」）將首先審核潛在借
application of the potential borrower, and conduct appropriate pre-loan or pre-     款人之申請，並對潛在借款人及其擔保人進
lease checks on the potential borrower and its guarantor, which involves (a)        行適當貸前或租前審查，包括 (a) 審核潛在
reviewing the financial reports and statements of the potential borrower; and (b)   借款人之財務報告及報表；及 (b) 對潛在借
performing an assessment on the financial condition of the potential borrower       款人及其權益持有人（針對實體）之財務狀況
and its equity holder(s) (for entities), such as the type and value of assets       進行評估，如潛在借款人所擁有之資產類型
owned by the potential borrower.                                                    及價值。


Depending on the type and amount of the financing services, the Business Units      根據融資服務種類及金額，業務部門將於考
will assess and decide the necessity and the amount of security/collateral          慮包括但不限於還款歷史、對借款人公開信
for the granting of each loan or lease on a case by case basis considering the      譽查詢之結果、借款人所擁有之資產價值及

          capital flows and other factors, which exposed enterprises to significant           跨境貿易、海外投融資等業務面臨顯
          currency risks in cross-border trade, overseas investment and financing             著的匯率風險。為規避國際貿易中的
          activities. To mitigate potential risks such as foreign exchange losses             匯兌損失等匯率潛在風險，本集團制
          in international trade, the Group formulated and implemented multiple               定並落地多項針對性防範舉措，做好

          fluctuation risks.

          During contract negotiations, the Group prioritized favorable settlement            在合同談判中，本集團優先選擇有利
          currencies (such as RMB or the primary expenditure currency) and                    的 結 算 貨 幣（如 人 民 幣 或 主 要 支 出 貨
          established exchange rate hedging clauses. Simultaneously, we                       幣）並訂立匯率保值條款。同時，優化
          optimized settlement methods by prioritizing wire transfers or sight                結算方式，爭取採用電匯或即期信用

          we adopted a forfaiting way to achieve rapid repayment and lock in                  則通過福費廷業務處理，實現快速回
          exchange rates immediately, thereby reducing risk exposure at its source            款並即時鎖定匯率，從根源上減少風

     DISCLAIMER ON NON-GAAP FINANCIAL MEASURES                                           非公認會計原則指標的免責聲明
     Affiliated HDT export revenue is a non-GAAP financial measure and it is used        聯營重卡出口收入為非公認會計原則指標，
     for assessing the Group’s actual export performance. The Group treats the type      該指標用於評估本集團的實際出口表現。本
     of sales to dealers who purchase the Group’s HDTs and directly export to their      集團將經銷商購買本集團重卡後直接出口至
     overseas customers as our export sales. Hence, it may not be comparable to          其海外客戶的銷售類型視為出口銷售。因
     similarly titled measures for other companies and should not be considered          此，聯營重卡出口收入未必可與其他公司的
     as an alternative to revenue by geographical markets as an indicator of the         同類指標作比較，也不應被視作地區市場收
     operating performance of the Group.                                                 入（本集團業務指標）的替補。


     The use of non-GAAP financial measure is provided solely to enhance                 非公認會計準則指標的提供僅為加強投資者
     the overall understanding of the Group’s current financial performance.             對本集團現時財務表現的整體理解。此外，
     Additionally, since the Group has historically reported non-GAAP results            由於本集團以往也向投資者報告若干非公認
     to investors, it is considered the inclusion of non-GAAP financial measure          會計原則指標以反映本集團業績，因此本集
     provides consistency in the Group’s financial reporting.                            團認為非公認會計原則指標可使本集團的財
                                                                                         務報告保持一致性。

NON-COMPETITION UNDERTAKING                                                       不競爭承諾
In order to protect the Group’s interests, CNHTC entered into a non-competition   為了保障本集團利益，於 2007 年 11 月中國
undertaking (the “Non- competition Undertaking”) with the Group in November       重汽提出不與本集團競爭的承諾（「不競爭承
2007. The Board has received an annual confirmation from CNHTC for its            諾」）。董事會已收到中國重汽遵照不競爭承

2.4. MATERIAL ACCOUNTING POLICIES (continued)                                        2.4. 重要會計政策（續）
    IMPAIRMENT OF FINANCIAL ASSETS                                                     金融資產減值
    The Group recognises an allowance for expected credit losses (“ECLs”)              本集團就並非按公允價值計入損益持
    for all debt instruments not held at fair value through profit or loss.            有的所有債務工具確認預期信貸虧損
    ECLs are based on the difference between the contractual cash flows                （「預期信貸虧損」）撥備。預期信貸虧
    due in accordance with the contract and all the cash flows that the                損乃基於根據合約到期的合約現金流
    Group expects to receive, discounted at an approximation of the original           量與本集團預期收取並按原始實際利
    effective interest rate. The expected cash flows will include cash flows           率的概約利率折現的所有現金流量之
    from the sale of collateral held or other credit enhancements that are             間的差額釐定。預期現金流量將包括
    integral to the contractual terms.                                                 出售所持抵押的現金流量或組成合同
                                                                                       條款的其他信貸提升措施。


   GENERAL APPROACH                                                                    一般法
    ECLs are recognised in two stages. For credit exposures for which there            預期信貸虧損分兩個階段進行確認。
    has not been a significant increase in credit risk since initial recognition,      就自初始確認起未有顯著增加的信貸
    ECLs are provided for credit losses that result from default events that           風險而言，預期信貸虧損提供予由未
    are possible within the next 12 months (a 12-month ECL). For those                 來 12 個月內可能發生違約事件而導致
    credit exposures for which there has been a significant increase in credit         的信貸虧損（12 個月預期信貸虧損）。
    risk since initial recognition, a loss allowance is required for credit losses     就自初始確認起經已顯著增加的信貸
    expected over the remaining life of the exposure, irrespective of the              風險而言，不論何時發生違約，於餘
    timing of the default (a lifetime ECL).                                            下風險年期內的預期信貸虧損均須計
                                                                                       提虧損撥備（全期預期信貸虧損）。


    At each reporting date, the Group assesses whether the credit risk on a            於各報告日期，本集團評估自初始確
    financial instrument has increased significantly since initial recognition.        認後金融工具的信貸風險是否大幅增
    When making the assessment, the Group compares the risk of a default               加。在進行有關評估時，本集團會就
    occurring on the financial instrument as at the reporting date with the            金融工具於報告日期發生違約的風險
    risk of a default occurring on the financial instrument as at the date of          與金融工具於初始確認當日發生違約
    initial recognition and considers reasonable and supportable information           的風險進行比較，並考慮合理且可靠
    that is available without undue cost or effort, including historical and           的毋須付出不必要的成本或努力即可
    forward-looking information. The Group considers that there has been a             獲 得 的 資 料， 包 括 過 往 及 前 瞻 性 資
    significant increase in credit risk when contractual payments are more             料。本集團認為當合同付款逾期 30 天
    than 30 days past due.                                                             以上時，信用風險顯著增加。

      17. LEASES                                                                         17. 租賃
          THE GROUP AS A LESSEE                                                              作為承租人
          The Group has lease contracts for various items of leasehold land,                 本集團擁有用於營運的各類租賃土
          buildings and motor vehicles used in its operations. Lump sum payments             地、樓宇、車輛的租賃合同。自土地
          were made upfront to acquire the leased land from the owners, and no               所有人處租賃土地通常一次性預先付
          ongoing payments will be made under the terms of these land leases.                款，而根據土地租賃條款，將不會繼
          Leases of buildings generally have lease terms between 1 and 5 years.              續支付任何款項。建築物租賃一般租
          Motor vehicles generally have lease terms between 1 and 5 years and/               賃期限為 1 至 5 年。汽車的租賃期限一
          or are individually of low value. There are several lease contracts that           般為 1 至 5 年和╱或個別價值較低。一

                                                                                          及應付票據。

          denominated and settled in RMB. The major foreign exchange risk                 以人民幣列值及結算。主要的外匯風

          translation risk.                                                               應付款項，須承受外幣折算風險。

   CAPITAL MANAGEMENT                                                                         資本管理
   The primary objectives of the Group’s capital management are to                            本集團資本管理的主要目標為保證本
   safeguard the Group’s ability to continue as a going concern and to                        集團持續經營的能力，並維持穩健的
   maintain healthy capital ratios in order to support its business and                       資本比率以為其業務提供支援及最大
   maximise shareholders’ value.                                                              化股東價值。


   The Group manages its capital structure and makes adjustments to it in                     本集團管理其資本架構並根據經濟狀
   light of changes in economic conditions. To maintain or adjust the capital                 況的變動對其作出調整。為維持或調
   structure, the Group may adjust the dividend payment to shareholders                       整資本架構，本集團或會調整支付予
   or issue new shares. The Group is not subject to any externally imposed                    股東的股息或發行新股份。本集團毋
   capital requirements. No changes were made in the objectives, policies                     須受任何外部實施的資本要求所限。
   or processes for managing capital during the year ended 31 December                        截 至 2025 年 12 月 31 日 止 年 度， 資 本
   2025.                                                                                      管理的目標、政策或過程並無任何變
                                                                                              動。


   Similar to the others in the industry, the Group monitors capital using the                與業內其他公司相同，本集團以資本
   gearing ratio. This ratio is calculated as net debt divided by total capital.              負債比率來監察資本。該比率以負債
   Net debt is calculated as total borrowings (including “current and non-                    淨值除以總資本計算。負債淨值包括
   current borrowings” as shown in the consolidated statement of financial                    借款總額（包括於綜合財務狀況表披露
   position), less cash and cash equivalents. Total capital is calculated as                  的流動及非流動借款），減去現金及現
   “equity” as shown in the consolidated statement of financial position plus                 金等價物。總資本為綜合財務狀況表
   net debt.                                                                                  中權益總額和負債淨值之和。

      五年財務概要


      In September 2023, the Group made further capital contribution to Tongxin           於 2023 年 9 月， 本 集 團 進 一 步 向 智 行 數 智
      Zhixing and then Tongxin Zhixing became a subsidiary of the Company.                科技增資及後智行數智科技成為本公司附屬
      Tongxin Zhixing becoming a subsidiary of the Company was considered to be a         公司。由於本集團及智行數智科技在進一步
      business combination under common control as the Group and Tongxin Zhixing          增資前後均為山東重工共同控制，故智行數
      are under common control of SDHi both before and after the further capital          智科技成為本公司附屬公司一事視為共同控
      contribution. Accordingly, the results, assets and liabilities of Tongxin Zhixing   制下的業務合併。因此，智行數智科技的業
      should have been accounted for at historical amounts in the consolidated            績、資產和負債需以原賬面值計入本公司綜
      financial statements of the Company as if Tongxin Zhixing had always been           合財務報表內，猶如智行數智科技一直為本
      part of the Group. The above financial figures for year 2021 are not adjusted       集團的一部份。上述 2021 年的財務數據未
      with inclusion of those of Tongxin Zhixing.                                         包含智行數智科技的財務數據。
